# Public Project Slippi replay fixtures

Gzip-compressed originals from https://github.com/project-slippi/slippi-js/tree/master/slp,
downloaded 2026-11-27. Names match upstream. The upstream repository is LGPL-3.0;
these are test inputs, not a runtime dependency on slippi-js.

- unranked_game1.slp: format 3.14, short singles replay
- doubles.slp: format 1.2, four players
- FodPlatforms.slp: format 3.17, dynamic platform events
- incomplete.slp: unfinished replay, rejected

Synthetic fixtures are generated by `scripts/generate_replay_fixtures.mjs` using
only documented event layouts. They cover rollback removal of items/platforms,
Ice Climbers, Sheik/Zelda transitions and missing optional animation fields;
invalid counterparts cover player/frame/container allocations, required nonfinite
positions, unsupported characters and event boundaries. Server/browser tests use
the same compressed corpus. These generated inputs contain no private game data.
